description: The brand's Mailchimp AUDIENCES (lists): subscribed member count, total contacts, unsubscribes, double opt-in, the default from name and email, and when each last sent. An audience id is what create_mailchimp_campaign and sync_leads_to_mailchimp take. Read-only, free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Settings > Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: list_mailchimp_audiences
title: List Mailchimp audiences
